stack: Google Apps Script HTML with Bootstrap 5.3 and existing POS CSS tokens

decisions.details: Separate Distribute items and Split bundle panels. Center bundle navigation; use toggles up to three bundles and a dropdown for more. Put Add Item beside the item table. Keep only the selected bundle count and remove Delivery Summary cards.
Use a soft pink header with a time-of-day greeting, the employee’s first name, and one encouraging line. Place the Today, Yesterday, and This week selector above its date label.
